briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind escalate frontier model releases as multi-agent systems proliferate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with new model launches from major labs and surging compute investments. Regulatory scrutiny grows while vulnerabilities persist in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic's Claude 4.5 shows gains in long-context reasoning; DeepSeek-V3 and xAI Grok-3 updates push open-weight boundaries.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act amendments target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell GPUs at scale; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k+ H100 equivalent clusters; TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols outpace safety alignment efforts by 2027?
